correctness.rationale: Every pointed rank-one formula in the pure named two-equivalence language is determined by four existential witness flags. Bipartite support cell degrees and weights realize exactly those flags. The existence of any zero fourth flag forces all cells into one row/column cross and at most five types; otherwise there are at most eight. All eight demand four singleton cells and four double cells, proving minimum cardinality twelve. The explicit partitions realize them. At the minimum the two isolated cells and the two weight-distinguished core cells force three incidence cases with four distinct assignments each. The proof of all statements is structural; two separate self-contained verification sources replay all twelve templates and exhaustive finite checks through twelve elements.

value.rationale: Two named equivalence relations are a natural finite-model-theoretic language with substantial expressive and decidability literature. The exact maximum number of coexisting rank-one one-types, sharp minimum structure size, and complete named-isomorphism classification of all minimum extremizers resolve a motivated small-model/local-diversity question. The result exposes a concrete obstruction imposed by intersecting two partitions and gives a reproducible finite benchmark; no general satisfiability complexity improvement is claimed.
